description: Monthly Traffic Volumes - Permanent Counters is a series of datasets listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Monthly traffic volume statistics from Permanent counters for the period October 2010 to December 2010. This includes Monthly Average Daily Traffic (MADT), Monthly Average Weekday Traffic, Monthly Average Weekend Traffic, and Monthly Average Daily Traffic by Length bin using the BC 5-bin scheme. Coverage: Government of British Columbia. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Its tags are TRAN, highway, mot, traffic, volume. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
